ambiguities.detail: examples/express-server/package.json pins '@trpc/server': 'npm:@trpc/server' (registry copy), overriding preferWorkspacePackages. The same specifier resolves to workspace src in packages/* but to node_modules in examples. The resolver must honor the 'npm:' protocol per importing package.

Example apps wire tRPC routers to framework adapters; API 'routes' are procedure names, not HTTP paths. Enumerating them needs adapter call-site detection + router object traversal — out of v0.1-alpha scope (tRPC enumeration covers validated patterns only).
www is Docusaurus (docs/blog -> URL by file convention); slugs can be overridden in frontmatter — file path is the default, not guaranteed.
examples/.*/* dot-dir workspaces (.experimental, .railway, .test) — glob enumerators that skip dotfiles miss them.
